path.title: FDU - Pathway Programs for Conditional Admission

codes.title: FDU - Testing Codes and Score Reporting

test_policy.notes: Freshman admissions page: standardized test scores are optional, except for several partnership programs (for example the joint 8-year program with LECOM, per College Navigator). For English, SAT EBRW 480 or ACT English 22 is also accepted by the English proficiency page.

requirements.notes: International applicants (anyone needing a visa) apply through FDU's international application (fdu.edu/myintlapp); Common App is used by U.S. citizens. Needs academic records from all secondary schools, English test or exemption, two academic letters of recommendation, passport copy, and bank statement plus affidavit of support for F-1. The $50 fee is from College Navigator and the CDS; the international pages do not state a fee.

deadlines.label: International fall 2027 application deadline
deadlines.notes: Rolling admissions, allow 3-4 weeks for processing. Spring (January) deadline is December 1. The page gives no year, so fall 2027 is assumed. Applicants already living in the U.S. have an August 1 fall date on the pathway page. Deadlines may vary by program.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Exempt at application with: U.S. college English Composition I (C or higher); two years at a U.S. high school with passing college-prep English; or at least two years of study in a listed English-speaking country (UK, Ireland, Canada except Quebec, Australia, New Zealand, Nigeria, Singapore and others). New students may still be tested at orientation and placed in the English for Professional Success (EPS) course.

english.notes: Regular (direct) admission. The Pre-University Program accepts 50; conditional admission needs no new score.
The page prints 70/4.5 for TOEFL iBT without naming the scale; 4.5 is assumed to be the new 1-6 band score. Pre-University Program 3.5.

aid.notes: FDU International Scholarship of up to $24,000 per year for first-year international students, based on academic merit, SAT/ACT not required, renewable up to four years, awarded at admission. Global Housing Grant $3,000 (Metropolitan campus residents). Conditional admission through the Pre-University Program (one semester, English for Professional Success courses; TOEFL 50, IELTS 5, Duolingo 80, PTE-A 45) is available to students below the direct English requirement.

cost.notes: FDU international estimate for 2026-27: tuition, fees and medical insurance $42,799 plus room and board $17,000 = $59,799; excludes books and personal expenses. The $42,799 figure combines tuition, fees and medical insurance and is not split on the page

sat.note: Metropolitan Campus (Teaneck) code; same code listed for TOEFL and GRE. Florham is 2262.

act.note: Same ACT code for both campuses.
